title: The Swan Song of Matrilineal Clans: The Walking Marriage Customs and ...
text: Abstract: As an ancient Tibetan group, the Zhaba are known for their distinctive languages and wedding customs. Their most representative practice is "walking marriage," a matrilineal marriage system that highlights the authority of maternal kin and helps sustain long-standing modes of production and everyday life in the Zhaba region.
